noise.host_class: shared WSL2 development host; background load uncontrolled

c0f.signal_definition: axis.status == "ok" and predicates.ratio_interpretable == true; timer threshold 1000 ns

alternative_lifetime.note: No per-row live-version lifetime exists in V10/F0. Evidence bound is 0..100% of signal Go time; no credit.

materialization.note: No per-row materialization-work counter exists in V10/F0. Evidence bound is 0..100% of signal Go time; no credit.

recovery.note: Observable error-class proxy; not a causal recovery counter.

scanner_boundary.note: No per-row scanner-call density exists in V10/F0. Evidence bound is 0..100% of signal Go time; no credit.

formulas: signal = {row | axis.status == ok and c_median_ns >= timer_threshold_ns}; hygiene rows stay in coverage and fixed-overhead reporting
ratio_by_total(class) = sum(go_median_ns over class) / sum(c_median_ns over class)
go_share(class) = sum(go_median_ns over class) / sum(go_median_ns over signal)
local_go_gap(class) = 1 - sum(c_median_ns over class) / sum(go_median_ns over class)
projected_saving_fraction = projected_saved_go_ns / sum(go_median_ns over measured signal rows)
percentile_q = linear interpolation at q * (n - 1) over sorted per-row ratios
cohort ceilings are evidence bounds; they are not performance credit until runtime attribution facts exist

conflicts.claim: 77-79%, approximately 50%, and 78-82% are competing scheduler shares
conflicts.finding: The accepted C0 profile assigns different named boundaries. Wide scheduler-family shares are 80.3-84.8%; dispatch plus reductions are 47.6-56.2%.
conflicts.action: Do not use any legacy percentage without its boundary.

conflicts.claim: The sealed v9 equal-fixture ratios identify the fleet mechanism share
conflicts.finding: The sealed board contains ratios and A/A nulls, but no component profile. The local C0 profile is a different host and diagnostic instrument.
conflicts.action: Keep C0e ratios and C0e noise evidence separate from C0f fleet shares.

conflicts.claim: The V10 fleet can assign recovery, alternative lifetime, scanner, and materialization shares
conflicts.finding: The V10 scoreboard and F0 manifest contain class, stop, timing, recovery memo, and oracle fields. They contain no retry count, recovery-cost counter, live-version lifetime, scanner-call density, or materialization-work counter.
conflicts.action: Do not admit a mechanism or claim the 2% selection ceiling until a trace lane supplies these facts.

conflicts.claim: The 1000 ns hygiene threshold was predeclared before V10
conflicts.finding: F0 records 1000 ns as a fixed reporting policy, but the V10 metadata has no timer calibration or pre-run threshold record.
conflicts.action: Treat the F0 hygiene denominator as queryable evidence, not sealed C6f acceptance proof, until threshold provenance is attached.

conflicts.claim: The R1 39.0% error-byte share is the V10 denominator
conflicts.finding: F0 signal bytes give 84,094,345 / 260,884,819 = 32.2343%. R1 does not define the 39.0% byte denominator, so the values cannot be reconciled from this artifact.
conflicts.action: Publish both denominators and do not blend them.
